mutant.description: The negative arm was measured, not derived, on both the criterion that failed and the amendment that rescued it. When AC2 failed post-act, the benign explanation was TESTED before the failure was called an instrument defect -- and the amended check was then re-falsified before its pass was accepted.
mutant.expected: At the base all three ACs FAIL (the halves: no capture, or a capture and no act -> 179 left, at_read not 0, pack removed 0). Post-act all three pass. Where a criterion fails after the act, the rollback trigger is armed and the failure must be explained by measurement, never by argument. Where a check is AMENDED, the amendment must not blind it.
mutant.observed: POST-ACT: AC1 PASS, AC3 PASS, AC2 FAILED 12 of 12 on one limb only -- 'other keys unmoved (moved: [model])' -- while all five substantive limbs passed on all 12 (at_read -> 0, on_object = pre at_read, count unchanged, sentences byte-equal, basis READ_GATE_PLUS_OBJECT). THE FAILURE WAS MEASURED BEFORE IT WAS CHARACTERISED: a leaf-by-leaf diff of the model subtree gave CHANGED = 1 of 5533 leaves on ASML, 1 of 5454 on VLO and 1 of 5076 on BABA, and that single leaf was /generated_at, 19:37Z (capture) -> 19:54Z (read). It was then confirmed STRUCTURALLY rather than by timing luck: comp-read enumerates all 10 generated_at assignments in scoped_amgt.py as _now_iso(), a read-time stamp, so the limb is act-independent and could not have passed for any act whose two reads straddle a minute. The check's VOLATILE exclusion was applied to TOP-LEVEL key names only, so a stamp nested one level under the model key made the whole key compare unequal. An empirical two-read control was also run but is reported as INCONCLUSIVE rather than claimed: both reads landed in the same minute (20:01Z), so they agreed; the pre/post evidence and the _now_iso() reading carry the finding. THE ROLLBACK WAS NOT TAKEN AND NOT SELF-ADJUDICATED -- both rollback routes stayed live throughout, and the issuer ruled independently the same way (msg 27355, AMENDMENT 2 @9d5bd13f74). RE-FALSIFIED AFTER THE AMENDMENT, by this seat rather than inherited: a nested NON-volatile plant (VLO model.cases.base.px_last.value 382.86 -> 383.86) still FAILS the amended AC2, exit=1, so dropping stamps at every depth did not blind the check.
